Subject: AWS Marketplace listing: claims tone + PrivateOffer CTA — quick copy QA

Hey team,

I finished a pass on the product page copy for Acme Analytics' listing and attached v3 (redwood-aws-hero-blurb-v3.docx). Two quick asks before I push to the seller console:

1) Claims/legal tone: We currently say "99% inference uptime" in the hero. Legal flagged this as a possible SLA claim — can we reword to the benefit without an exact percent? Suggestion: "highly available, production-grade inference."

2) PrivateOffer / CTA placement: Acme wants a prominent PrivateOffer CTA that links to a trial request flow. I've mocked an image (screenshot-cta-placement.png). Need product/ops sign-off on whether that CTA can route to a PrivateOffer landing with entitlement checks.

I also added an AMI/entitlement checklist tab in the spreadsheet (ami-visibility-checklist.xlsx) — please scan for anything missing (seller ID, region tag parity, govcloud caveats).

Can you both review and reply with in-line notes by EOD PDT? Paul from Acme is looping us for a short field demo next week, so timeline is tight.

Thanks —
Kim

Head of Marketplace Programs

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing: claims tone + PrivateOffer CTA — quick copy QA

Kim —

Thanks for the draft. Quick notes after a read-through:

- Hero claim: agree we should avoid a hard percent. Prefer the phrasing: "Engineered for production reliability and low-latency inference." It's specific enough for customers and less like a contractual SLA.

- Evidence/Trust section: we reference SOC2 and audit logs; add a one-line "Detailed compliance and deployment options available on request" so legal can point prospects without exposing specifics.

- PrivateOffer CTA: good to surface, but don't put it as the primary hero CTA. Primary should stay "Try a hosted demo" (lower friction for self-serve). PrivateOffer can be a secondary button + inline copy: "Request a PrivateOffer for dedicated capacity and enterprise terms." See my suggested copy in comments of your doc.

- AMI checklist: unfinished — I flagged a missing role mapping for cross-account access in us-west-2. Jonas, can you confirm the current recommended role name for the seller-managed AMI?

I'll also add a 1-line SEO-friendly kicker under the hero (short keyword: "LLM inference, low latency, predictable cost").

-M

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Apr 2026 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing: claims tone + PrivateOffer CTA — quick copy QA

Following up on Marissa's AMI note —

Checked with infra. Seller-managed AMIs should expose the role: "RedwoodSellerCrossAccountAccessRole" (case-sensitive). I'll add that to the spreadsheet and include the minimal policy snippet. Also a couple of ops constraints for PrivateOffer routing:

- PrivateOffer flow: Partner Ops (Amazon) needs the landing path to accept a seller ID querystring param; otherwise, the entitlement check fails. I can mock a redirect that includes seller_id and region.
- GovCloud: PrivateOffer isn't available in GovCloud for our standard SKU; flag this in the checklist and add the suggested fallback text: "Contact sales for FedRAMP/GovCloud options."

I'll attach the policy snippet in a separate message (keeping it out of the public doc for now).

-Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Product Manager, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Couple quick asks from Acme:

1) Can the "Try a hosted demo" CTA pre-fill our account name and ideal test dataset (we'll provide a S3 sample link)? That would speed evaluation.
2) For the PrivateOffer copy, can you add a line about "pricing subject to committed capacity" so field knows it's not an always-on freebie.

We're good with the adjusted hero phrasing Marissa suggested. Happy to be on the demo next Wednesday — send calendar invite and any prep deck.

Thanks,
